title: WillKim Harness: all 6 PreToolUse guards
desc: Complete reference for all guards in D:\GitHub\wkharness.ps1. Read when a guard blocks you or to understand the design.
steps: OVERVIEW: single PreToolUse hook, user+project dual registration for hot-reload. Budget shared weekly across ALL repos. Self-test: powershell -File D:\GitHub\wkharness.ps1 -Test (expect 10/10 PASS).
GUARD 1 ASK-GUARD [Bash/PS]: blocks wkappbot ask/whisper run_in_background=true. Fix: remove run_in_background.
GUARD 2 KILL-GUARD [PS]: blocks Stop-Process/Kill-Process on wkappbot-core/wkchat/wkappbot/wka11y. Fix: wkappbot taskkill /IM <exe>.
GUARD 3 SKILL-SEARCH-NUDGE [Bash/Glob/Grep]: soft exit-0 nudge to run skill search before grepping. No block.
GUARD 4 SKILL-EDIT-GUARD [Edit/Write]: blocks direct .skill.json edits. Fix: skill edit <id> or skill contribute.

GUARD 5 PACE-GUARD [Edit/Write, Sonnet only]: blocks when sonnetPct > totalPct. Forces delegation. EXEMPT: memory/*.md and CLAUDE.md. When blocked: Agent(model:opus) or Agent(model:haiku) with exact brief, NO code splits.
GUARD 6 CP949-GUARD [Write]: blocks CP949-incompatible chars. Fix: ASCII or Hangul only.

GUARD 7 AGENT-BRIEF-GUARD [Agent]: blocks Agent tool calls whose prompt contains fewer than 3 'wkappbot skill read' references. Reason: agents start with zero context -- skill reads are the only briefing. Fix: add wkappbot skill read on-load + wkappbot skill read wkharness-guards + one task-relevant skill to Agent prompt.

GUARD 7 enhancement: after counting 3+ refs each skill ID is validated via wkappbot skill read SID -- if any skill does not exist delegation is blocked with the bad IDs listed. This forces callers to verify skill IDs before briefing agents.

GUARD 8 OPUS-BUDGET-GUARD [Agent, opus model]: blocks Agent(model:opus) when totalPct >= 95% of weekly budget (133M tokens). Reads pace-guard cache. When blocked: use Agent(model:haiku) with exact brief (NO code splits), or wait for Thursday 07:00 KST reset.

GUARD 9 STALL-GUARD [all tools except Agent, Sonnet session]: detects solo tool-call loops. Tracks streak via $env:TEMP/claude_stall_guard.json. Resets on session change or 120s gap. Blocks after 300s + 10 calls if totalPct less than 90 percent. Message: delegate to Opus. Agent tool calls are exempt (delegation is the fix).

GUARD 9 update: Read tool exempt from stall-guard (passive lookup). GUARD 8 update: opus-budget-guard also fires when totalExceeded=true (weekly pace exceeded), not only at 95% hard limit -- prevents Opus binge-spending.

GUARD 10 BG-TASK-GUARD [all tools]: mark-on-launch, erase-on-Read pattern. State: $env:TEMP/claude_bg_pending.json. When Bash/PS runs with run_in_background=true -> records pending mark. When Read tool file_path matches pending output -> erases mark. On any tool call -> stale marks >30s block with 'check your background task output'. Marks auto-evict after 10min.

CODEX HARNESS (2026-05-15): Two-layer approach. Layer 1 -- wkcodex.ps1 wrapper (pre/post checks, skill ref enforcement, bypass flag injection). Layer 2 -- ~/.codex/rules/default.rules forbidden rules: decision='forbidden' blocks specific prefix_rule patterns NATIVELY inside Codex even without bypass flag. Valid decision values: allow, prompt, forbidden (NOT deny). forbidden rules stop commands at the exec_policy layer before execution. Use forbidden for kill-guard patterns targeting wkappbot/wkchat/wka11y. Limitation: prefix_rule matches exact command array prefix only -- no regex. Use wkcodex.ps1 pre-check for regex-based guards. Admin-level rules: requirements.toml with rules.prefix_rules (applies to all users).

CODEX CONFIG HOOKS DISCOVERY (2026-05-15): config.schema.json contains 'properties.hooks', 'features.codex_hooks', 'features.plugin_hooks', 'definitions.MatcherGroup.properties.hooks'. These may allow specifying external harness scripts per-command. Also: 'zsh_path' sets shell binary path -- if a similar key exists for PowerShell, a custom shell wrapper could intercept every Codex command at execution time. NEXT: fetch raw schema to confirm hook structure and whether script paths are configurable. This would enable real-time encoding/kill/skill guards inside Codex without wrapper.

CODEX HOOK SYSTEM (2026-05-15) -- Claude Code-compatible: Codex config.toml supports the SAME hook events as Claude Code. Events: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PermissionRequest, SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, PreCompact, PostCompact. HookHandlerConfig: type='command', command (unix), commandWindows (Windows path). Add to ~/.codex/config.toml: [hooks] PreToolUse = [{type='command', commandWindows='powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File D:\GitHub\wkharness.ps1'}]. This reuses wkharness.ps1 directly -- same stdin JSON format as Claude Code hooks. features.codex_hooks = true may be required to enable. features.plugin_hooks = true for plugin-based hooks. PermissionRequest hook can gate execution (replaces approval interception approach). PostToolUse hook can replace wkharness-post.ps1 pattern for Codex. Result: wkharness.ps1 single file covers BOTH Claude Code AND Codex sessions.

CODEX HOOKS LIMITATION (2026-05-15): [hooks] config in config.toml does NOT fire in 'codex exec' non-interactive mode. Tested with debug script -- no log output even with [features] hooks=true and --enable hooks flag. Hooks only work in interactive TUI mode (codex command, not codex exec). FINAL CODEX HARNESS STACK for exec mode: (1) wkcodex.ps1 wrapper -- task-level pre/post checks, (2) default.rules forbidden rules -- exec_policy prefix blocking, (3) AGENTS.md behavioral rules. Interactive mode gets hooks too. Keep [hooks] config for future exec support.

CODEX TUI STDIN INTERCEPTOR LIMITATION (2026-05-15): wkcodex-harness.ps1 implements stdin/stdout pipe interception for 'codex -a on-request' TUI mode to intercept approval prompts and apply guards. LIMITATION: codex TUI detects non-TTY when stdin/stdout are redirected and produces no output -- process hangs silently. Requires ConPTY (Windows Pseudo Console) or wkappbot a11y automation of a real terminal window to work. wkcodex-harness.ps1 kept as research artifact. Real-time command-level harness for codex exec is currently impossible without ConPTY or binary modification.

GUARD 11 AGENTS-HEAL-GUARD [any tool, once per session]: on first tool call of new session, checks project AGENTS.md for Commit Gate section. If missing -> injects it via Add-Content (no Write tool needed). If AGENTS.md absent -> creates it. Uses $env:TEMP/claude_agents_heal.json to run only once per session_id. AGENTS.md is also added to pace-guard exempt paths (alongside memory/*.md and CLAUDE.md).

GUARD 12 COMMIT-HOOK-GUARD [Bash/PS, git commit]: when git commit is detected, auto-ensures global core.hooksPath points to ~/.codex/githooks AND copies tools/cp949_save_guard.ps1 to the repo if missing. This makes CP949 encoding enforcement self-installing -- any repo that runs git commit gets the hook automatically. Source of truth for cp949_save_guard.ps1: D:/GitHub/personal-docs/tools/cp949_save_guard.ps1. GUARD 11 update: agents-heal-guard now also injects Skill Reference Requirement section into AGENTS.md alongside Commit Gate.

USAGE MODES (2026-05-16): (1) HOOK MODE (default): stdin JSON piped from Claude Code/Codex PreToolUse hook -> reads tool_name/tool_input/session_id -> applies guards -> exit 0=allow exit 1=block. Auto-detected when stdin is redirected or parent process is not a terminal. (2) STATUS MODE: powershell -File D:/GitHub/wkharness.ps1 -Status  OR run with no args from a terminal (parent=powershell/WindowsTerminal/cmd/etc). Outputs: pace guard (Total%/Sonnet%/target/hogging), wkappbot license (user/repo/tier), guard count + self-test hint. (3) SELF-TEST MODE: powershell -File D:/GitHub/wkharness.ps1 -Test  -> runs 31/31 test cases covering all guards including edge cases (backslash paths, mangled JSON, skill ref counts, pace exemptions). JSON PARSER: 4-stage robust parser -- Stage1 normal ConvertFrom-Json, Stage2 fix unescaped backslashes, Stage3 fix control chars, Stage4 regex field extraction (survives completely malformed JSON). RAW PRE-CHECK: agent tool_name detected in raw text before parse -> skill ref count checked immediately -> blocks before parse even runs. SYMLINK HUB: D:/GitHub/wkharness.ps1 -> D:/GitHub/personal-docs/tools/wkharness.ps1 (canonical). PostToolUse hook: D:/GitHub/wkharness-post.ps1 (bg task completion marks).

TIMEZONE/RESET NOTE: pace-guard and Codex usage tracking use Korea Standard Time (KST) with Thursday 07:00 KST (Claude) and Thursday 18:00 KST (Codex) as weekly reset points. These are correct for Korean Anthropic/OpenAI accounts. For other regions: update TotalLimitM/CodexLimitM params and the reset hour in wkharness.ps1 to match your account's actual reset schedule. The harness auto-calibrates actual limits from rate_limit_event data once a weekly/monthly limit is hit -- so first-week estimates may be off.

REGION CUSTOMIZATION (for non-KST users): wkharness.ps1 has 3 REGION-SPECIFIC comment blocks marking timezone-dependent code. Search for '# ── REGION-SPECIFIC' in the script. Each block: (1) Claude pace-guard reset: 'Korea Standard Time' + AddHours(7) = Thu 07:00 KST. (2) Codex pace-guard reset: 'Korea Standard Time' + AddHours(18) = Thu 18:00 KST. (3) Codex Status section: same as (2). To customize: change the timezone ID string (run [System.TimeZoneInfo]::GetSystemTimeZones() | Select Id to list) and the AddHours(N) value to your account's actual weekly reset time. Auto-calibration (rate_limit_event + Codex rc) will correct the limit amounts after first hit -- only the reset time needs manual adjustment.

GUARD BLOCK MESSAGE STYLE (2026-05-16): All guard block messages follow a consistent format: (1) stderr only -- no Write-Host, all output via [Console]::Error.WriteLine. (2) No ASCII banners (no === border lines). (3) Header: '[guard-name] BLOCKED: one-line reason (context values)'. (4) Blank line, then 'How to fix:' with numbered steps specific to that guard. (5) Closing mandate line where applicable: 'Do NOT ... -- that is a harness violation.' Full detail goes to ~/.claude/agent_delegation.jsonl (for agent guards) -- console stays concise and AI-readable.

CODEX-DONE MARK (2026-05-16): wkharness-post.ps1 now sets claude_agent_skill_pending.json mark on both Agent tool completion AND codex exec/wkcodex completion. This triggers agent-done-skill-guard to block next Agent() call until skill is updated. Pattern match: tool_name in Bash/PowerShell AND command matches codex exec OR wkcodex.

SESSION-INIT REFACTOR (2026-05-17): consolidating all once-per-session heal guards (wkcodex symlink, AGENTS.md, git hooks, MCP registration) into single session-init block with marker file claude_session_init_<sessionId>.json. Runs once per session on first tool call, logs '[session-init] wkcodex + agents.md + git-hooks + mcp'. Replaces scattered individual heal guards.
